//Identity: GitHub sign-in + optional allowlist. CLIENT SECRET in user-secrets, NOT here. Callback https://localhost:8210/api/identity/callback (dev). Empty ClientId/ClientSecret => host boots, /health works, sign-in returns 503 until set. AllowedGitHubLogins EMPTY => OPEN (any GitHub user, self-hosted); populate ONLY to lock an exposed instance (others get 403).
//Catalog: The hubs whose catalogs Wheelhouse merges, lists and imports from, in order: each Repository (owner/name), Path (relative file, default catalog.yml) and Ref (branch, default main), read with the signed-in owner's GitHub token. An empty list reads these three.
//Vault: The built-in Secrets Vault. KeyFile: its root key, one line of base64 holding 256 bits, root-only on the control host and copied offline; empty reads {Deployment:Root}/vault/root.key; a missing file leaves the vault sealed. Mode: builtin, or external for one release after the merge to render secrets from the standalone vaults again.
//Mcp: The SDK MCP request guard's options. AllowedOrigins: browser origins (scheme://host[:port]) that may call /mcp besides the console's own; a foreign Origin gets 403, a request without one (CLI clients) passes. MaxRequestBodyBytes: the body cap, 65536 by default; a larger body gets 413.
